title: oreogrammitis ligulata

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
